seo.title: About me · Mónica Trujillo
seo.description: Meet Mónica Trujillo, how she works and her recent activity on GitHub.

about.title: about me
about.p1: A while ago I read a phrase by the designer Josep Lluscà that stuck with me: "Designing is anticipating the life that does not exist yet". That is exactly what happens to me when I create software.
about.p2: That is why my favorite part of everything in my degree is making mockups. I like to sit down, plan the interfaces and figure out how to build them.
about.p3: Away from screens, I am passionate about fashion and modeling, and I try to bring that same elegance and aesthetic to every application I design.
about.quote: Design gives shape to an idea; code makes that idea work.
about.interest: I am interested in managing digital projects and giving a good solution to the people who use them.

seo.title: Projects · Mónica Trujillo
seo.description: Websites, mobile apps and designs I have created, with the problem each one solved and the solution.

arquimo.name: Arquimo
arquimo.summary: Property listings for rent and sale, with a search filter by type of deal and a floating contact button.
arquimo.problem: The website was old, outdated and mixed suppliers with the rental and sale of properties.
arquimo.solution: I gathered all the up-to-date information and designed a site with a filter to search properties and tell whether they are for sale or for rent. I added a floating contact button on every screen so people can reach out quickly.

mota.name: MOTA Dental Laboratory
mota.summary: Internal mobile app to follow the stage of every order, from the milling machine to shipping.
mota.problem: The organization was poor: when a zirconia crown or similar work was ordered, material got lost and it almost never reached the client on time.
mota.solution: I built an internal app that shows each order's stage (milling, design, shipping) and records whether it was defective or badly designed and sent back. When the order is ready, it notifies the doctor.

padelOne.name: Pádel One
padelOne.summary: Mobile app to pick a studio, book a court or class and keep track of every reservation.
padelOne.problem: Clients booked through WhatsApp or Instagram and sometimes nothing was confirmed: courts ended up taken or the teacher never showed up to the class.
padelOne.solution: I designed an app where you choose your studio, book, and everything is recorded and confirmed in one place.

facialByLimary.name: Facial by Limary
facialByLimary.summary: New website for a spa in New York, with up-to-date services and staff.
facialByLimary.problem: The site was built on WordPress and outdated: it listed staff who no longer worked there and services that were no longer offered.
facialByLimary.solution: I made a clean, elegant page with current information and services.

gosaHoteles.name: Gosa Hotels
gosaHoteles.summary: Redesign using the brand colors, better organized and faster to load.
gosaHoteles.problem: The page didn't use the brand colors, had too much information and took a long time to load.
gosaHoteles.solution: I redesigned the site with the same information better organized, a different layout and faster loading.

tiatsa.name: Tiatsa
tiatsa.summary: Website to browse the company's tractor inventory and suppliers.
tiatsa.problem: The company had no place where it could show the tractors available for industry or its suppliers.
tiatsa.solution: I built a website to see what is in stock and what is not, keeping the inventory in order.

floreDiLuna.name: Flore di Luna
floreDiLuna.summary: Figma design of a shopping experience for an exclusive, personalized perfume.
floreDiLuna.problem: The goal was for buying a perfume to feel special and unique for women, with the option to create a personalized one.
floreDiLuna.solution: I designed the full experience of choosing and building your own perfume in Figma, with an exclusive, polished style.
